summary.zh: 修复 modelswap skill add 交互选择器:之前的 prompts 调用方式在该库版本上不存在,交互模式一打开即崩溃;已切换为与 vault 交互流程一致的对象式调用并实测通过。
summary.en: Fixes the modelswap skill add interactive picker: the previous prompts calls used an API that doesn't exist in prompts@2 and crashed on open; switched to the object form proven in the vault flows and verified end-to-end.

highlights.zh: 修复:运行 modelswap skill add 进入交互选择时立即报错(prompts.select is not a function)。现与 vault 交互流程使用同一套成熟调用,选择 Agent、勾选技能、落盘安装全流程实测通过。
highlights.en: Fixed: entering the interactive picker crashed immediately (prompts.select is not a function). It now uses the same proven object-form prompts calls as the vault flows; select-agent → multiselect-skills → install was verified end-to-end in a pseudo-TTY.
